title: A stage-back rerun after a kill leaves a new file the dead run copied in untracked and out of the commit
goal: a stage-back rerun after a kill takes over a new file (one the worktree had none of at dispatch) that the dead run copied in, and commits it with the other copies

run:
import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile,json
sys.path.insert(0,os.path.abspath("_tools"))
import bl_dispatch as D
t=tempfile.mkdtemp(); wt=t+"/wt"; sc=t+"/scratch"
subprocess.run(["git","init","-q",wt],check=True)
subprocess.run(["git","-C",wt,"-c","user.email=a@b","-c","user.name=n","commit","-q","--allow-empty","-m","base"],check=True)
p=".claude/new.md"
os.makedirs(sc+"/staging/.claude"); open(sc+"/staging/"+p,"w").write("new\n")
os.makedirs(wt+"/.claude"); open(wt+"/"+p,"w").write("new\n")        # a dead stage-back had copied it in: untracked, equal to its copy
json.dump({p:None},open(sc+"/"+D.BASES_NAME,"w"))                    # dispatch records None as the base of a file the worktree had none of
D.staged_files=lambda bl,iid:[p]
from pathlib import Path
D.staged_places=lambda bl,iid,w,x:(Path(wt),Path(wt)/x,Path(t)/x)
got=D.half_copied(None,"ST-x",Path(wt),Path(sc))
print("half_copied found",[g[0] for g in got],"(a stage-back rerun leaves the new file untracked and out of the commit)")
sys.exit(0 if got else 1)
